Definition: an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh
BiblicalUsage: ʼElqôshîy is a plain word for an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh. In Nahum 1:1, the text says "The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, ʼelqôshîy, I take at face value: an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh.
